recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — shared-types + employee read support
recommended_phases.rationale: Add LeaveRequestQueryParams.employeeIds to shared-types; add IEmployeeRepository.findPasswordHashByEmail/findByManagerId and IEmployeeService.getEmployeesByManagerId. No dependents yet; smallest leaf changes.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — auth module + migration
recommended_phases.rationale: Add password_hash migration, IAuthService/AuthService, POST /auth/login route, public-path registration. Depends on Phase 1 employee repository method.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — balance read endpoint
recommended_phases.rationale: Extract resolveAccrualPeriod into balance module, add IBalanceService.getBalanceForEmployee, GET /balances/me route. Depends on Phase 1 employee service.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4 — leave read endpoints
recommended_phases.rationale: Add ILeaveService.list/getById with role scoping, GET /leaves and GET /leaves/:id routes. Depends on Phase 1 employee service and existing leave repository.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 5 — employee/me route + smoke + unit tests
recommended_phases.rationale: GET /employees/me route, extend scripts/smoke.js with login+read stages, add unit tests for new routes/services. Depends on all prior phases.

app_notes: Application slice for Authentication + read endpoints. New `auth` module (POST /auth/login) plus read routes on employee (GET /employees/me), leave (GET /leaves, GET /leaves/:id), and balance (GET /balances/me). Dependencies flow inward: auth/leave/balance/employee -> shared-types/shared-errors/shared-db/shared-auth; leave -> employee; balance -> employee+policy. No module depends back on leave. Read endpoints never open a transaction and never write. Login uses existing bcrypt/jsonwebtoken; token payload matches shared/auth contract (sub=id, role=EmployeeRole). password_hash added via migration (t.text, nullable). Wrong email vs wrong password indistinguishable (same 401 + message).

open_questions.question: How should the accrual-period derivation be shared between LeaveService.resolveBalance and the new GET /balances/me path?
open_questions.impact: The feature requires GET /balances/me to derive the accrual period "exactly as LeaveService.resolveBalance does it" without re-deriving. The periodContaining/addMonths/startOfUtcDay helpers currently live as private methods on LeaveService; balance cannot import them without a leave->balance reverse dependency.
candidate_options: Extract periodContaining/addMonths/startOfUtcDay into a shared helper (e.g. src/shared/types or a new shared/date module) and have both leave and balance import it
Move resolveAccrualPeriod into the balance module as a public function and have LeaveService call it (leave already depends on balance)
Duplicate the derivation in balance (violates the no-re-derive constraint)

open_questions.question: What is the exact visibility scope for MANAGER on GET /leaves and GET /leaves/:id?
open_questions.impact: The spec says MANAGER sees "their own plus those of employees whose manager_id is the manager". Whether this is a single-level direct-report scope or transitive (reports of reports) affects the employee repository query and the list/getById authorization check.
candidate_options: Transitive subtree (all descendants under the manager)

auth_contract: request.user: { id: string; role: EmployeeRole } where EmployeeRole = 'EMPLOYEE' | 'MANAGER' | 'ADMIN'. Identity/role obtained from a JWT bearer token verified by the existing registerAuth preHandler hook (src/shared/auth/index.ts), which populates request.user; token payload is { sub: id, role }. RBAC enforced at the route boundary via resolveActor (role membership check) and in the service (role-scoped visibility for list/getById); never inline in route handlers. POST /auth/login is added to the PUBLIC_PATHS set so it is reachable without a token.
error_response_contract: Errors return { error: string; code: string }. Validation failure -> HTTP 400 (ValidationError, code VALIDATION_ERROR); authentication failure -> 401 (UnauthorizedError, UNAUTHORIZED); authorization failure -> 403 (ForbiddenError, FORBIDDEN); not found -> 404 (NotFoundError, NOT_FOUND); invalid state -> 409 (ConflictError, CONFLICT); other -> 500. Login failure (wrong email OR wrong password) returns the SAME 401 + message to prevent account enumeration. GET /leaves/:id returns 404 for both "not found" and "not visible" (indistinguishable).
